problem: Production /en routes existed and language switching navigated correctly, but /en/prijzen still rendered the Dutch H1.
root_cause: The production build had STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=0. When the versioned translation cache was incomplete, build-localized-routes.mjs intentionally returned null translations and wrote English routes from the Dutch source with data-bg-static-translated=false.
prevention: Production English generation must never silently publish Dutch source text.
STATIC_I18N_NETWORK must be enabled for production until the versioned translation cache is complete.
Translation provider failures are terminal production-build failures.
Language release closure requires NL to EN to NL browser proof on homepage, pricing and systems/koppelingen.

evidence.browser_failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1
